clarification.en: Procyclical policies are deliberate actions that amplify cycles, whereas automatic stabilizers are built-in mechanisms that naturally act in a counter-cyclical manner.
clarification.hi: Procyclical policies are deliberate actions that amplify cycles, whereas automatic stabilizers are built-in mechanisms that naturally act in a counter-cyclical manner.

relationship.en: Fiscal policy acts as the primary tool to either dampen or amplify the business cycle.
relationship.hi: Fiscal policy acts as the primary tool to either dampen or amplify the business cycle.
